RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 3

The panel composition doesn't help you here. Both you and the successful candidate are men, so an all-male panel is very unlikely to have disadvantaged you on grounds of sex — and raising it would look like you were reaching for a grievance, weakening your credibility on the points that matter.

Those points are real: a two-week silence on a lawful request for written reasons, and a decision that appears to favour a candidate with less formal qualification and less civil service tenure on the strength of a vaguely worded criterion ("experience of leading international projects") that may not have been in the published requirements.

Chase the written reasons in writing, with a deadline. Then assess whether the criteria were applied consistently.
